notes: Signing out now warns you to back up first, so a tap can't wipe your data by accident
Credit-card due dates show up reliably, even when the bank's SMS leaves out the year
Money spent on a credit card now counts towards what you owe, with its own line in 'What you owe'
The whole app now speaks Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil and Gujarati
Ask Paisook is smarter: compare months, counts, 'when did I last…', averages — and you can add an expense just by typing it
